Frontend admin queue UI verified (renders with sanctions-page testid + 3 tabs pending/clear/flagged + MANUAL (MOCK) flag), full decision modal flow PASS (review → pick-clear → reason → submit → row moves from pending to clear tab). ClientGateBanner verified on /client for client.admin@alemany.capital — banner correctly shows 'VERIFICACIÓN DE ANTECEDENTES EN CURSO' which means alemany's sanctions_status is pending (Andes validated but compliance hasn't cleared yet). Regression: landing, /apply toggle individuo↔empresa, login/dev-login redirect, and 403 on unknown emails all still work. Resend gating (drop dev_otp / nullify magic_link when RESEND_API_KEY is set) verified via static source assert (we never set RESEND_API_KEY in tests, per task spec). Webhook gate proven: after fiat.account.created, sanctions_screenings row is pending+manual, org.kyb_status stays pending, user.status stays invited.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/sanctions.py L86-102 — when a row already exists in pending and the new screen() returns a conclusive status, the patch is applied AND we return `{**existing, **patch}` but we do NOT mirror the audit log entry. Minor: every auto-decision should also be audit-logged (currently only the initial enqueue is logged).

routes/ramp_webhook.py L385-397 — sanctions enqueue happens AFTER the CVU/onboarding_status mirror is set. If enqueue_screening raises (caught) the CVU still ends up in ramp_accounts and the org stays sanctions=pending forever. Today there's no retry/backfill mechanism; consider a periodic job that re-scans orgs with cvu but no sanctions_screenings row.

integrations/email_sender.py — resend send timeout is hard-coded to 10s with no retry; consider exponential retry-once on 5xx so a transient Resend hiccup doesn't lose the OTP (current fallback only writes the row, doesn't re-attempt).

routes/sanctions.py decision endpoint — when decision=clear AND Andes hasn't yet emitted CVU, we silently leave kyb_status=pending. The activation will only happen if a fresh fiat.account.created arrives later. If Andes already processed BEFORE sanctions enqueue (race), there is no re-trigger. Worth adding a periodic reconcile or call into the activation block from both endpoints.

rca of the issue: No bugs found. The sanctions gate is correctly wired end-to-end: (1) /onboarding/apply seeds sanctions_status=pending, (2) fiat.account.created webhook calls enqueue_screening (ManualProvider returns pending) and refuses to flip kyb_status because sanctions_status != clear, (3) admin queue + decision endpoints flip both org.sanctions_status and conditionally activate (clear + Andes ok) or reject (flagged → kyb_status=rejected + users paused), (4) /me + /client/me surface sanctions_status/sanctions_locked/can_operate, (5) admin UI renders correctly with all required testids and decision modal works, (6) ClientGateBanner shows the right Spanish copy for pending. The 9-test backend file plus the Playwright UI run together cover every numbered case in the review request.
